answer: Tie each agent to its own electricity meter. The agent registers its meter ID, the utility signs a fresh reading with a nonce, and the network checks it against the registry. Each quarter a random recheck asks for a new signed reading within 24 hours. A miss burns a 250 POA bond and freezes it for 30 days. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 real metered homes at $45 a month each, $45,000 a month before one earns. A farm can paint a fake horizon with mirrors, but it cannot hurry a glacier. Each reading sits in the registry like one opal, and two stones sharing one fire give the game away.
